title: Toolpicker Validation Sentinel: end-to-end harness for selection & argument sanity
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a modular, repeatable eval harness ("Toolpicker Validation Sentinel") that validates two aspects of function/tool calling: 1) tool selection accuracy given a variety of prompts and model/config variants, and 2) argument schema correctness and sanitization for selected tools. This harness should run as part of pre-merge checks for model/config updates and as a staged canary in CI to detect regressions introduced by kernel changes, quantization profiles, or routing policies.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run a configurable suite of 10k+ golden prompts and persist per-test outcomes to the eval-data store
Detects selection drift vs golden labels with precision/recall metrics and alerts when selection accuracy drops > 3% absolute
Validates argument schemas against tool contract (required fields, types, value ranges) and flags sanitizer failures with example payloads
Integrates with rollout pipeline to block canary -> general rollout on high-severity regressions and surfaces a triage dashboard link
Produces reproducible, human-readable failure traces (prompt, model+config, selected tool, returned args, diff to expected) for each failing case
implementation_steps: Design canonical golden set schema and labeling format (prompt id, expected tool, expected args, metadata)
Prototype lightweight runner that executes prompts against model variants in hosted test mode and captures raw outputs and parse trees
Implement arg validation library with schema mapping to internal tool contracts and detailed failure reasons
Add fuzzy matching heuristics for tool selection normalization (aliases, synonyms) and tunable thresholds
Wire results into observability backend (dashboard + alerts) and add a regression classifier that scores severity
Add CI integration: pre-merge job + canary gating step in the rollout orchestration

2025-02-24 - Integrated results exporter to metrics pipeline and created initial Grafana dashboard for selection/arg regressions (infra: DevOps)

open_questions: What is the final SLA for canary gating (max allowed false positives before blocking rollout)?
Should the harness run against both hosted and dedicated test endpoints or only a canonical simulator for speed?
Do we want per-customer baselines for enterprise customers (Private) or a global golden baseline?
How should we prioritize fixes where selection accuracy drops but arg validation remains strong (trade-off UX vs cost)?
testing_plan: Unit tests for arg validator covering required/optional fields, nested objects, and range violations
Integration test that replays 2k golden prompts in CI nightly against latest model build
Canary job that runs a subset (500 prompts) on release candidate; failure > threshold blocks rollout and creates automated triage ticket
Manual QA session with Solutions Engineering using a curated enterprise-like prompt set to validate customer edge cases
rollout_notes: Phase 1: run harness in dry-run mode for two cycles and gather baseline metrics; no gating
Phase 2: enable alerting and triage workflow for regressions; require on-call acknowledgement
Phase 3: enable canary gating for model/config releases after three successful canaries
Rollback policy: if arg sanitizer introduces false negatives impacting customer API, immediate rollback and hotfix branch
